facts.fact: Adwave advises that a lead magnet should deliver a win in under 10 minutes.
facts.quote: Your lead magnet should deliver a win in **under 10 minutes**.

facts.fact: Adwave suggests a short video tutorial lead magnet of about 5 minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave says a 50-page ebook is not the right format for a lead magnet.
facts.quote: This isn't the time for a **50-page** ebook.

facts.fact: The page states that marketers who segment their email lists see a 760% increase in revenue from their email campaigns, with no named source given.
facts.quote: Marketers who segment their lists see a staggering **760%** increase in revenue from their email campaigns.

facts.fact: The page states that about 4.6 billion people are expected to use email by 2026, with no named source given.
facts.quote: With **4.6 billion** people expected to use email by 2026 and **99%** of them checking their inbox daily

facts.fact: The article recommends an automated welcome series of 3-5 emails sent to every new subscriber over a few days or weeks.
facts.quote: This is typically a sequence of **3-5 emails** that are automatically sent to every new subscriber over a few days or weeks.

facts.fact: In the suggested welcome series, Email 2 is sent 2 days after signup.
facts.quote: **Email 2 (2 Days Later):** Share your origin story or a key piece of advice related to their problem.

facts.fact: In the suggested welcome series, Email 3 is sent 4 days after signup.
facts.quote: **Email 3 (4 Days Later):** Offer another high-value freebie, like a link to your most popular blog post or a helpful how-to video.

facts.fact: In the suggested welcome series, Email 4 is sent 7 days after signup.
facts.quote: **Email 4 (7 Days Later):** Build social proof by sharing a powerful customer success story or a glowing testimonial.

facts.fact: The article cites a third-party source (onlinetechhub.com) claiming email marketing delivers a 36:1 return on investment.
facts.quote: email marketing delivers a staggering **36:1** return on investment

facts.fact: The article cites onlinetechhub.com as saying automated sequences sent to engaged lists drive 37% of all email revenue.
facts.quote: Automated sequences sent to these highly engaged lists drive **37%** of all email revenue

facts.fact: The article cites onlinetechhub.com as saying automated sequences make up just 2% of email sends.

facts.fact: The article cites onlinetechhub.com as saying automated sequences achieve open rates of nearly 49%.
The article states that real results can be seen with as few as 100 engaged subscribers.
facts.quote: You can start building relationships and even driving sales with as few as **100 engaged subscribers**.

facts.fact: The article contrasts a list of 100 engaged subscribers with a list of 10,000 uninterested subscribers, claiming the smaller engaged list will outperform.
facts.quote: A tight-knit list of **100** people who look forward to your emails will always outperform a list of **10,000** who couldn't care less.

facts.fact: The article recommends sending one thoughtful email per week as a starting rhythm for a new list.
facts.quote: Sending one thoughtful email per week is a fantastic rhythm to get into.

facts.fact: The article says many email marketing platforms offer generous free plans, often covering up to 1,000 subscribers.
facts.quote: There are plenty of fantastic email marketing platforms that offer generous free plans, often for up to **1,000 subscribers**.
